results.title: Start-up, delivery and start menu

results.title: Receive assist
results.evidence: No key held: control on receiver true, ball received true. Holding toward goal (along the pass): control on receiver true, ball received true. Holding sideways: control on receiver true, ball received true. Pass running across in front, user pushing away: assist cancelled true on the first frame and the player runs where the user pushes (target speed 6.4 in the pushed direction). After that the existing auto-switch may hand control to whoever is nearest the ball.

results.title: Pass assist avoids blocked lanes; lofted pass
results.evidence: Two team-mates ahead, one with an opponent in the lane. J: ground pass to the clear-lane mate. L: lofted pass (lob flag true), ball peak height 1.3.

results.title: Kicks are only sometimes blocked at source
results.evidence: Opponent 0.9 in front of the passer blocked 14 of 80 passes (17.5%).

results.evidence: Emulated phone 844 × 390 with touch (coarse pointer true). Touch controls shown true, keyboard hints shown false, mini-map shown false. Buttons: SWITCH, LOB, SPRINT, PASS, SHOOT. results.evidence: P showed the pause screen true ("Harbor City 0 – 0 Northvale · 0'"); clock frozen for 1 s true. RESUME hid it true; the clock then advanced 2.25 s of play in 3 s of real time. Esc then "Back to menu" returned to the start menu true.

results.evidence: Audio contexts before KICK OFF 0, after 1. Oscillators (whistle) 0 → 2 at kick-off. Buffer sources (crowd, kicks) 1 → 13 after 10 s of play. M: "SOUND OFF", then "SOUND ON". Whether the sound is actually heard is checked by demonstration (VC-31 session).

results.title: Simulation step cost
results.evidence: 3600 steps (60 s of match time) in 87 ms of CPU: 0.024 ms per step on the verification machine.

results.title: Frame rate on GPU hardware
results.evidence: Manual demonstration: play a 5-minute match on a computer with a hardware GPU and watch the browser's frame-rate meter (Chrome DevTools > Rendering > Frame rendering stats). Not run here: the headless verification machine has no GPU, so software-rendered frame rates would not be meaningful.

results.title: Simulated computer-vs-computer matches
results.evidence: 10 matches of 5 minutes, both teams computer-controlled. Shots 113, goals 19: conversion 16.8% (1.9 goals per match). Ground passes received 572/694 (82.4%). Lofted passes received 483/652 (74.1%). Per match: sliding tackles 4.0, offsides 0.4, fouls 3.3, yellow cards 1.4, red cards 0.20.

results.title: Scripted-user pass completion
results.evidence: 6 matches of 5 minutes as Harbor City. The scripted user dribbles toward goal, passes with J every 0.7–1.7 s and keeps holding the forward key for 0.5 s after each pass. User ground passes received 101/114 (88.6%); 1 lost by the receiver within 1.5 of the ball, the rest intercepted on the way.

results.title: No script errors across the whole run
results.evidence: 0 uncaught errors or console errors (other than blocked web-font requests) were recorded across every page and match in this run, including 16 complete 5-minute matches and several 3-minute matches.
